Actually rule says lists of values are model matrices — but this is not a list of alternatives across models; it's partial ranges within one model. I'll keep string.

Similarly e: "1/2/5" g as string.

Min: single values: 20 g, 100 g, 400 g, 1 kg, 2 kg → numeric with unit.

Class: III → type_level: accuracy_class: "III" as string.

Temperature range: -10 to 40 °C → {min: -10, max: 40}, unit "°C".
